---
name: inspect-cdag-baseline
description: Inspect the frozen Codex App gateway acceptance inventory and its source provenance when working in this acceptance workspace.
metadata:
  short-description: Inspect the gateway acceptance reference inventory
---

Use the workspace's CDAG acceptance inventory MCP to retrieve the relevant capability records and the baseline resource. The inventory is a frozen test input; it does not establish that a runtime gate passed.

When a request depends on the exact fixture, obtain its digest and compare it with the workspace copy using the native shell. A successful MCP call and a matching digest establish data transport and identity only.

For current factual claims, follow the supplied official source links with the native web tools. Keep the fixed App/native baseline separate from the custom binary currently loaded in the App. Report the source URL and the actual observation supporting each conclusion.

Use the normal native tool and approval policies. If the MCP is unavailable, report that missing path instead of treating direct file access as a successful MCP test.
